single_rule.base_owner: one request-local HiGHS owner and one base cell LP for every admitted case
single_rule.optimal_negative: select every screened phase row that is primal-tight under the frozen tolerance and has a strictly negative upper-row marginal
single_rule.infeasible: select every mapped phase row with a finite, exact-nonzero coefficient in a validated HiGHS dual infeasibility ray; if no valid mapped support exists, return UNKNOWN
single_rule.update: flip the complete selected set simultaneously once, rebuild/reload once under the same owner contract, and solve once
single_rule.positive_terminal: raw BOX, verifier-owned zero-width outward forward, and strictly positive stored-binary64 Fraction property lower bound

loader_contract.solver: one pinned highspy/HiGHS implementation for base status, marginals, and infeasibility ray
loader_contract.tiny_coefficient_rule: for a dropped term in A*x<=b, use exact stored-binary64 Fraction b' = b - sum(min(a*l,a*u)), then round toward +inf
loader_contract.warning_or_error: poison owner, bounded clear, and UNKNOWN
loader_contract.partial_mutation: poison owner, bounded clear, and UNKNOWN
loader_contract.cleanup: a cleanup failure cannot replace the primary BaseException
loader_contract.deadline: checked before every load/update stage and passed to HiGHS
loader_contract.postconditions: row, column, nnz, primal, dual/ray shape, finite values, and row mapping

gate_order: safe loader and dual-ray toy audit
